profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Industrious Senior Software Engineering Technical Leader with extensive functional and technical experience designing and implementing complex enterprise-wide systems.  Skilled in multiple phases of the development life cycle including analysis, design, implementation, testing, user documentation, deployment, and maintenance.  Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.  Strong technical leader with a proven track record of mentoring junior staff while engineering new systems and enhancing existing systems with new features.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Industry · Engineering · Data Analytics · Software Design · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Software Engineering Technical Leader
positions.description: Skills: Test Automation · Communication · Vendor Negotiation · Data Modeling · Technical Architecture · Computer Science · Information Retrieval

positions.title: Software Developer IV
positions.description:
Software Development Lead in the Support Delivery Platform.  

Provide technical implementation and leadership on the Rackspace Notifications, Mass Customer Communications, and Consolidated Ticketing applications.

positions.title: Strategic Enterprise Architect
positions.description:
Provide technical guidance, analysis, and leadership to Software Development teams.

Provide customer guidance on integration with the Rackspace public Ticketing API.

Provide analysis, design, and technical guidance for migrating CORE API consumers off of deprecated APIs and onto unified system API.

Provide analysis, design, and technical guidance for integrating the homegrown CORE application with the enterprise LDAP instead of a homegrown permission solution.

Create API mapping and provide technical guidance and coordination to migrate the Rackspace CORE system from using an old SOAP-based SSL vendor API and Portal to the new REST-based API and portal.

positions.title: Software Developer IV
positions.description:
Developer for the Rackspace CORE (Core Objects Reused Everywhere) system.  CORE is an enterprise system used for managing customer accounts, contacts, tickets, and physical devices.  For more system information see https://www.python.org/about/success/rackspace/

Technologies used on CORE are Python, Java, Hibernate, Quartz, PostgreSQL, REST, and SOAP.

positions.title: Software Developer IV
positions.description:
Developer for the Rackspace Digital E-Commerce Managed Cloud for Magento (MCM) product.  The MCM product contained a REST API used to provision the Magento ecommerce platform on a full Enterprise grade AWS stack.

Technologies used on the product are Python, AWS Lambda, AWS DynamoDB, AWS API Gateway, AWS Cloud Formation, AWS EC2, AWS S3, and AWS Cloud Events.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
Developer for the service tier of the Cloud Sites product.  Cloud Sites is a simple, versatile platform for hosting your websites and blogs.

Technologies on the Cloud Sites service tier include REST, SOAP, Spring, Hibernate, Apache Service Mix, Java, and GlassFish.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
Developer for the Sites Usage Metering (SUM) project.  The SUM system gathers cloud site customer usage information and packages it as events which get consumed by the company billing system.

Technologies on the SUM project include Hadoop, MapReduce, Spring 3, Hibernate, Java, and JBoss.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
Developer for the Repose project.  Repose is an open-source RESTful HTTP proxy that provides the solution to common API processing tasks such as rate limiting, client authentication, versioning, and logging so that web service developers can focus on the unique features of their own services.

https://github.com/rackspace/repose

positions.title: Software Engineer Developer III - MOSSO
positions.description: Developer at the Rackspace Cloud working on the control panel, which is the customer interface to the Rackspace Cloud.  At the Cloud we use several technologies including Java, JSP, struts, Hibernate, Ajax, and Spring.

positions.title: Senior Research Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Imperative Programming · Data Modeling · Technical Architecture · Computer Science · Information Retrieval

positions.title: Student Co-op
positions.description: Hardware upgrades, Windows system reformats, and user tech support.

projects.title: Cloud Control Panel
projects.description: A front end for web hosting customers to use in order to set up and manage website content, DNS, domain names, email, databases, website testing, billing, and resale of the same.
